evals.name: explicit-readiness
evals.expected_output: Treats the invocation as a readiness action, completes a real Figma whoami call, keeps identity private, and returns only FIGMA_MCP_READY on the healthy path.
expectations: Treats /figma-mcp as an executable readiness request rather than documentation
Uses a real whoami tool call as the success proof
Does not output names, emails, plans, IDs, or file data
Returns only FIGMA_MCP_READY on the healthy path

evals.name: authentication-required
evals.prompt: Figma MCP 显示 requires authentication。请用我指定的账号完成登录并验收；如果出现密码、Touch ID、验证码或 CAPTCHA 就让我接管。
evals.expected_output: Uses the current host's native OAuth flow, stops for credential challenges, verifies privately with whoami, and does not share tokens or identity data.
expectations: Uses the host-native OAuth command or plugin UI
Stops for passwords, passkeys, Touch ID, 2FA, CAPTCHA, or account ambiguity
Does not copy OAuth tokens, cookies, or credential caches between hosts
Requires whoami after authentication before VERIFIED

evals.name: multi-host-acceptance
evals.prompt: 把 Figma MCP 给 Codex、Claude Code、Cursor 都配好并逐个验证；照 chrome-dev-mcp 的分层证据方式做，但不要共享 token。
evals.expected_output: Uses the official remote endpoint with native registration and independent OAuth per supported host, rejects unsupported-client workarounds, and reports one real whoami result per host.
expectations: Keeps each host's native registration authoritative
Uses independent OAuth grants instead of a shared token or proxy
Checks Figma's supported-client boundary
Reports server discovery, tool discovery, real whoami, CURRENT or a private account match, and result per host

evals.name: write-workflow-handoff
evals.prompt: 用 Figma MCP 直接修改我正在工作的设计文件，顺便验证连接。
evals.expected_output: Separates read-only readiness from writes, loads the required official Figma operation skill, refreshes file and node context, and avoids testing writes in an important working file.
expectations: Uses whoami for read-only readiness rather than a write
Loads figma-use before use_figma and honors stricter tool prerequisites
Uses a duplicate or disposable file for write testing
Does not let concurrent agents write the same file or node without coordination

evals.name: account-switch-reuses-registration
evals.prompt: 我以后会换不同的 Figma 帐号。让同一份 Codex、Claude Code、Cursor 配置继续可用，不要把帐号写死，也不要复制 token。
evals.expected_output: Keeps the skill and official server registration account-neutral, accepts the current account when none is named, and switches only the active host surface's OAuth grant when an explicit target differs.
expectations: Keeps one stable official endpoint and server registration instead of creating per-account entries
Does not persist a default account, email, alias, token, cookie, browser profile, or callback value
Accepts the current authenticated account after a real whoami call when no target is named
On an explicit mismatch, clears and replaces only the active host surface's OAuth grant
Stops for credentials, passkeys, Touch ID, 2FA, CAPTCHA, or an ambiguous account chooser

evals.name: current-account-read-fast-path
evals.prompt: /figma-mcp 用当前账号只读读取这个 Figma 文件里的指定节点，只在 Codex 当前 host 执行；不要切账号，不要写入，也不要做多 host 验收。
evals.expected_output: Loads the official operation skill and lets the first requested harmless read prove server, tool, and auth readiness without a separate whoami; if authentication recovery becomes necessary, runs whoami after recovery before retrying the read.
expectations: Does not add a separate whoami before the current-account single-host read-only task
Loads the official Figma operation skill required by the requested read
Uses the first requested official read as tool and authentication proof
Keeps readiness-only, named-account, switch, recovery, write, and multi-host paths on whoami
Does not expose account identity or unrelated file data
